title: Imitation Of The First World
paragraphs: “Next is Sakura-chan.”
“Hmm…”
Seeing that, Sakura-chan pouts and glares. Of course, that’s only fair. Kissing Rival is something that should never happen.
“Naofumi kissed Gaelion… Sakura wanted one too…”
“Sorry, sorry, Sakura-chan.”
Father pats Sakura-chan on the head. Well, since they’re about the same size, it feels a little strange, like he’s patting a girl of the same age.
“Sakura-chan is the same kind of being as the Filolial that Motoyasu-kun likes.”
“Yeah, I get that… but Sakura likes Naofumi the most.”
“That’s perfectly fine. Sakura-chan is Sakura-chan, just like Motoyasu-kun said.”
“Should I go call Mel-chan?”
“No… I think it’s fine. Some things are better left unknown. More importantly, is there anything you want, Sakura-chan?”
“Hmm… I want a kiss from Naofumi too.”
“Well, after giving one to Gaelion, that’s only fair…”
Father granted Sakura-chan’s wish and gave her a kiss just like he did for Rival. Yes, yes, this is how it should be. That kiss with Rival was definitely a mistake.
“Yay!”
“Thank you for protecting me all this time. Right now, among the Filolials, Sakura-chan is the most important to me.”
“Yep! Sakura wants to stay with Naofumi too!”
Hmm… this is a complicated feeling. I care about Filo-tan, but I also care about Sakura-chan. However, since this world’s Father doesn’t know about Filo-tan, it can’t be helped.
“…Yeah. I guess I’m different from the version of me in the original world, just like how Sakura-chan is the same as the one called Filo.”
“Sakura is different from Rifana and Gaelion, so… it’s fine. I’ll let Gaelion off the hook.”
“Thank you, Sakura-chan.”
“Mm.”
Father pats Sakura-chan’s head as she nods energetically. Then, Father turns to big sister’s friend.
“I said this to Raphtalia-chan earlier, but… it really was like a miraculous dream.”
“Yeah, I felt the same way when I was trapped. The moment Motoyasu-kun and the others saved me and believed in me, that was the miracle.”
“Indeed.”
“…Rifana-chan, are you really okay with this?”
“Yes. I’ve already talked with Raphtalia-chan, so it’s fine.”
Father gently strokes big sister’s friend’s head. Big sister’s friend changes into her weasel form and climbs up onto Father’s shield.
“I wanted to do something for Rifana-chan… Is there anything? I can’t do anything too indecent, but if it’s something I can do, I’ll grant it.”
“I’m fine.”
“But…”
“Then… could you… pet me now?”
Her voice sounded a little shaky.
“Rifana-chan…”
Big Sister from this world calls out softly. Father gently pats big sister’s friend’s head with a kind expression. Big sister’s friend lets out a very contented sound.
Why is that? I feel like I’ve seen this scene somewhere before.
“Raphtalia-chan, is there anything you want?”
Big sister looks toward the Raph species version of herself.
“I’ve already received enough… from Naofumi-sama and the other heroes. Thank you for saving everyone.”
She bows her head politely and speaks to the Raph species version of herself. The village has been restored. I think it’s progressing just as well as the original world.

“That time… when I lost Rifana-chan… I don’t know what thoughts you had, what path you followed, or what joys and hardships you endured alongside Naofumi-sama. But seeing the way you look at Naofumi-sama and Rifana-chan… I realized that I’ve never reached that level of devotion.”
Big sister speaks to her other self as if looking at something dazzling.
“So please… I pray that you achieve your goal. Defeat the enemies… and the waves that bring misfortune to everyone.”
“Yes… I will definitely defeat them. The one who committed such atrocities… I will bring them down!”
Big sister and the Raph species version of herself shook hands. Then, big sister quietly spoke to her Raph species counterpart.
“Um… does your true form from the other world look different from how I look now?”
The Raph species version of big sister tilted her head slightly at the question and nodded gently.
“Then… I’ll show you, just for a moment, with magic.”
With that, she snapped her fingers. For just a few seconds, the Raph species version of big sister glowed, and I could see Big Sister from the original world. Yes, yes, this was how she looked.
“…If I do it too much, I might get blown away. That was close.”
“Wow…”
Big sister’s eyes sparkled. It was as if she had just witnessed something truly amazing.
“Raphtalia-chan, you were so beautiful.”
Big sister’s friend commented, and big sister nodded.
“Yeah!”
“Is there anything else?”
The Raph species version of big sister asked, but big sister shook her head.
“Was that really real?”
“Maybe there’s a bit of idealization in it. I mean, wouldn’t you want to show a dream to a child, even if it’s yourself?”

Itsuki and Ren were murmuring softly, low enough that the sisters couldn’t hear. There wasn’t a shred of idealization in that. Big Sister from the original world was exactly like that. The Raph species version of big sister seemed to hear them but wore an unbothered expression.
“If it’s true, maybe it’s like with Filo-san—there might be some kind of condition involved.”
“A condition…? Maybe developing romantic feelings for Naofumi during her growth period or something like that?”
“Ah… that does sound likely.”

These two really don’t know how to read the mood. Hmm? I feel like this conversation is coming back to me in some way… While I was lost in thought, big sister and the Raph species version of herself continued talking.
“Thank you very much. I’ll do my best… If this world manages to survive, I’ll work hard to become an adult like you.”
“Hmm… being encouraged by myself feels a little strange. How should I put it…? I feel like I’ve been a bit tainted.”
The Raph species version of big sister seemed a little downcast. What happened there?
“Have you both made up your minds now?”
“To be honest, I have mixed feelings.”
“Well… that’s to be expected.”
“Everything I’ve worked so hard for will be undone. I can’t help feeling that way.”
“Yeah, but even though it’s been tough since we were summoned, it hasn’t been bad. Maybe it’s wrong to say this, but I’ve had fun.”
“…Yeah, I agree. It was better than rotting away in despair over my abilities.”
“Since I’ve been able to feel this way… I think I’m a happier version of myself than the one in the original world,” Ren spoke with a serious expression.
Hmm, it seems both Ren and Itsuki have a lot on their minds.
“Motoyasu-san, we’re holding back too, so please do your best.”
“Of course!”
“…Alright. Motoyasu, make sure you take down whatever’s causing the waves. Make this world disappear. You can handle that much, right?”
“Absolutely!”
Ren and Itsuki looked a bit conflicted, but they agreed.
“Well, it feels like we made this decision on our own, but this world is going to disappear unless Motoyasu meets that Filo girl. We just have to accept it.”
“Yeah, that’s how it is.”
With that, Ren and Itsuki waited for the Raph species version of big sister to speak. Sensing this, she spoke to me.
“So, Spear Hero, are you ready?”
“Not really. I don’t want to abandon or give up on Father.”
“That’s just like you. I know that everything revolves around Filo for you.”
The Raph species version of big sister spoke with a sharp edge. That’s just like the version of Father from the original world.
“In the original world, I didn’t realize it, but I’ve come to understand that Father is actually a very kind person.”
“Hearing that makes me blush…”
“And Ren was an edgelord, and Itsuki was full of sarcasm.”
“What the…! You’re still saying that till the end!”
“Who are you calling sarcastic?!”
“Well, in the original world, I saw Ren and Itsuki before they changed after being deceived by the pig, but I think I learned more now.”
As I said that, Ren and Itsuki stopped being angry and just looked at me with exasperation. They must have a lot on their minds.
“Yeah, that’s true. Thanks to Motoyasu, we’ve been able to change. In the end, it’s the same as with Naofumi.”
“Exactly. Originally, we were just failures who relied on game knowledge, thinking we were always right. We know that now. Motoyasu-san, it’s thanks to all your advice that we’ve come this far.”
They’re so bad at being honest. As I was thinking that, Father, Ren, and Itsuki spoke up.
“It’s the same for that Filo girl. The environment will shape Sakura-chan.”
“To make sure we don’t forget that, we just need to make Naofumi follow the same path as in the original world.”
“Yes, that’s the process for you to return to your original world, Motoyasu-san.”
“And… please don’t forget about us. Remember the time we spent together. Even if it was just a dream.”
Father and the others all waved at me. It would be embarrassing if the Raph species version of big sister couldn’t activate the spear after this.
“Then, I’ll interfere with the spear now.”
“Please, make it work.”
“Of course. If it doesn’t activate, I won’t be able to face Rifana-chan, myself, or everyone here.”
“Good luck, Motoyasu-kun, Raphtalia-san.”
With Father’s encouragement, the Raph species version of big sister nodded and began chanting magic toward my spear.
“Here we go.”
The Raph species version of big sister activated the magic with intensity. The spear started vibrating.
“Ah, I just realized… If this fails, wouldn’t killing Motoyasu-san trigger the loop?”
“Whoa! Itsuki, seriously—”
Father’s exasperated voice was cut off. The icon that appears when the loop happens came into view. The world was now gray. …Even though this is me, I can’t help but feel a bit sad.
“Then, I hope you’ll meet Filo in the next loop.”
I glanced away from the Raph species version of big sister and looked at Rival. As expected, she was still in color.
“Do your best, okay? I’ll even cheer for you, just this once.”
Gah…! Getting cheered on by Rival completely kills my motivation! The hands of the clock started turning backward.

But… am I really going to go along with the pig’s trap and corner Father? I don’t want to do that. Even if it’s not me… Ren or Itsuki would surely lead Father to meet Filo-tan. That’s what I believe now. And so, I returned to the original world, looping once again.
